name: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash Video Editing
description: Edit a source video from a text prompt. Output inherits the source aspect ratio and resolution. Token-metered.

input_schema.description:
Edit an existing video. No aspect_ratio or resolution: the output inherits the
source video's. The source is bounded at 100 MiB and 10 seconds; the model rejects
a longer one.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the edit to apply.
prompt.title: Prompt

video_url.description: Source video to edit. At most 100 MiB and 10 seconds long.
video_url.title: Video Url

input_schema.title: Omni11VideoEditRequest
